name: molted
description: Wire Molted (agent-native email infrastructure) into an agent you're building: send/reply/read-inbox MCP tools, REST reference, and safe-default setup guidance.

api_key.title: Molted API key
api_key.description: Your Molted API key (mm_live_... or mm_test_...), from Settings > Access at https://molted.email/app/settings#access. A read-only, mailbox-scoped key is the safe default. Stored in your system keychain, never in settings.json.
